Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
predicted_sql:
WITH customer_data AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payments,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders,
        MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) AS earliest_purchase,
        MAX(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) AS latest_purchase
    FROM E_commerce.main.orders AS o
    JOIN E_commerce.main.order_payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    total_payments,
    num_orders,
    (total_payments / num_orders) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN (latest_purchase - earliest_purchase) < 7 THEN 1.0
        ELSE (latest_purchase - earliest_purchase) / 7.0
    END AS lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_data
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;
